title: Warn at turn end when a reply agrees without a verified label
action: Work in the worktree /mnt/data/Projects/goglbe/beehive--wt--verified-claims-triage (branch wt/verified-claims-triage). Add a Stop-hook check that enforces rule agents-verify-before-agreeing (packages/bee/LEADER.md). Contract: (1) New module packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/session_close/claims.rs, registered in session_close/mod.rs, exposing pub(crate) fn unverified_agreement_warning(events: &[serde_json::Value]) -> Option<String>. Input: the transcript events the Stop hook already reads (perf_events in run_inner; reuse them, never a second transcript read). It collects the TEXT of every assistant message of the LAST turn (same turn boundary rules as final_assistant_text_line in session_close/mod.rs, Claude and Codex shapes; reuse or generalise that walker rather than copy it). It returns Some(warning) only when ALL hold: (a) that text, lowercased, contains an agreement phrase from a fixed list — English: "you're right", "you are right", "good idea", "great idea", "sounds good", "sounds right", "makes sense", "i agree", "agreed"; Vietnamese: "đúng rồi", "bạn đúng", "anh đúng", "chị đúng", "hợp lý", "đồng ý", "ý hay", "chuẩn rồi"; (b) it contains no "[verified" label; (c) it contains no conditional marker: "checking", "check first", "kiểm tra trước", "để em kiểm tra", "để tôi kiểm tra". Otherwise None. The warning text is one line, plain English, naming the rule: "bee: this reply agrees with a proposal but carries no [verified] label — rule agents-verify-before-agreeing: check the key assumption first, then agree with what the check showed." (2) In session_close/mod.rs run_inner, on event "Stop" only, when the advisory outcome is Done or Crash (never on Block or Disabled), push that warning into parts before emit_hook_output so it reaches the session as the existing advisory output; the turn is never blocked, the exit code never changes, and the turn-end mark still receives the events (clone or borrow as needed). (3) Tests (TDD, red first): unit tests for unverified_agreement_warning covering: agreement without label -> Some; agreement with [verified] -> None; conditional 'sounds right; checking X first' -> None; Vietnamese 'hợp lý' without label -> Some; no agreement phrase -> None; agreement only in an EARLIER turn -> None; Codex-shaped events -> Some. Plus one test through the Stop hook entry (follow the existing pattern in session_close/tests.rs) proving the warning appears in the hook output for a Claude transcript. (4) No code comments at all (no //, ///, //!). (5) Add one sentence to packages/bee/LEADER.md inside the agents-verify-before-agreeing block: the Stop hook warns when a reply agrees without a [verified] label. Add a short concept paragraph to docs/knowledge/areas/hook-runtime/overview.md naming the check and its pointer file session_close/claims.rs. Do NOT run bee dev regen; the leader runs it.
